name: Andrzej Halicki, Matjaž Nemec - Après le § 57 - Am 59
title: REPORT on the Council position on the draft general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2026
part_text: 57b. Expresses opposition to allocation of budgetary appropriations for militarism, namely for war, weapons and military infrastructure, capacity and mobility; is against the ongoing escalation of militarisation of the EU; calls for EU budget funds earmarked for militarisation programmes to be reallocated to support Member States in improving the economic and social situation on the basis of the principle of social and economic cohesion, to strengthen public services’ response capacity, particularly in the areas of health, education and social security, and to defend the right to decent and affordable housing for all;
